extracts.quote: My favourite feature is Titan X. That's taking it from me doing something to me doing nothing. Well, not nothing, but it's learning from mine and everyone else's decisions over the past. There are things that I don't need to be sitting there clicking a button to say 'yeah, that's fine'. There are things that robots can do for us much better than probably any human can.
extracts.context: A pharmacy owner at an Avicenna branch identifying Titan X (AI) as his top feature, valuing its ability to learn from historical decisions and automate routine clinical approvals.

extracts.quote: It saves the pharmacist so much time. We're now able to spend more time with patients. So much more efficient than any other PMR.
extracts.context: Brief testimonial from a staff member summarising Titan's core impact in a single sentence.

extracts.quote: This is the biggest site yet. 25,000 items has been our biggest challenge. But the staff have taken well to it. They're understanding slowly, the process, and onwards and upwards.
extracts.context: Usif describing the go-live of his largest pharmacy (25,000 items) with robot integration -- the seventh Titan site in his group.

extracts.quote: Systems are fragmented, disjointed with multiple subscriptions. It's just all over the place, and that makes it hard to deliver pharmacy services and even harder to scale. That's why we built Titanverse. It brings everything together and uses AI to take the pressure off.
extracts.context: Wahid's product voiceover explaining the core problem Titanverse solves: fragmented service platforms across pharmacy operations.

extracts.quote: Using our built-in AI scribe, it listens during your consultation, writes the notes for you. No typing, just speaking and prescribing. Create prescriptions, digitally sign them and send them off to the pharmacy for dispensing.
extracts.context: Wahid describing the Titanverse AI scribe and prescribing workflow in the product overview script.

extracts.quote: Calendars, bookings, pre-consults, payments, documents, referrals, AI agents, all in one simple flow. If you're running pharmacy services or you want to, Titanverse is built for you.
extracts.context: Wahid delivering the closing product pitch of the Titanverse overview, listing the full feature scope.

extracts.quote: We decided this time we were going to do it on a quiet day, on a Saturday, giving the staff as much time behind closed doors to understand Titan without the phone ringing, without patients walking through the door. Went head on with batch flow, making sure they understood the process.
extracts.context: Yusuf describing his refined go-live strategy by pharmacy 11 -- choosing a quiet Saturday for staff training.

extracts.quote: It's been quicker. In terms of workflow, we've been able to tailor the workflow for it. Got people picking specifically to the pick sheet. People just standing there, getting the dispensing done. And that way we're getting more done in a short period of time.
extracts.context: Yusuf describing the organised batch flow workflow at his eleventh pharmacy on go-live day.

extracts.quote: Imagine using ProScript, quick and efficient for labelling, very good in terms of accuracy, but at the end of it, I've got a mountain to check as a pharmacist. Not all stores have the luxury of having checking technicians. Ultimately, the pharmacist has still got to stand there checking those prescriptions.
extracts.context: Yusuf describing the fundamental bottleneck of their previous PMR system where all checking still funnelled back to the pharmacist.

extracts.quote: With barcode scanning, that is being completely taken out the picture. The staff have to follow a strict process. One label at a time, one box at a time, you've completely eliminated the ability to make that error, and no other PMR at that time would have allowed you to do that.
extracts.context: Yusuf explaining how Titan's barcode validation removes human error from the dispensing process in a way no competitor offered.

extracts.quote: In any of our branches now with Titan, a pharmacist who isn't working with any ACT or any checking dispenser, your checking is down to probably between 20 to 30%, which is a massive change in time needed to be in the dispensary.
extracts.context: Yusuf quantifying the reduction in pharmacist checking workload when moving from 100% manual checking on ProScript to Titan's barcode-validated workflow.

extracts.quote: There is no other PMR company out there that allows its users to consider new innovative updates and new features and implements them as quick as Titan does. So many times using Canny, we've put suggestions through, and I'm not even exaggerating, within a month, they're normally done.
extracts.context: Yusuf comparing Titan's feedback-to-feature speed against the entire PMR industry, highlighting the Canny suggestion platform.

extracts.quote: How many companies do you know out there have a WhatsApp group with the software developer, the head of sales, the owner, all in that group, listening to everyone's suggestions? It doesn't happen. It doesn't happen anywhere in any industry.
extracts.context: Yusuf highlighting the unprecedented level of direct access Titan customers have to the development and leadership team.

extracts.quote: The whole point of this is that I've got my pharmacist in that consultation room, and that's where I want them to be.
extracts.context: Yusuf expressing the core outcome he values most from implementing Titan: pharmacists doing clinical work instead of standing in the dispensary.

extracts.quote: If you were to walk into our pharmacy at a busy hour, you'd probably feel like you walked into the checkout at Tesco's, because all you're hearing is beeping. Which means everyone's following the process, no override. Everyone's scanning the boxes, everyone's scanning the labels.
extracts.context: Yusuf describing what a visitor would notice about their Titan-powered workflow and the sound of barcode scanning in action.

extracts.quote: Everything felt a little bit more chaotic. It was organized chaos, but a little bit more chaotic, in the sense that with the Titan board there is a clear workflow. Previously I would just see prescriptions on the screen, a name and a date, not really easily able to configure my workflow.
extracts.context: Yusuf contrasting the disorganised screen of their old PMR with Titan's Kanban-style dashboard that provides clear workflow visibility.

extracts.quote: No more guesswork day to day.
extracts.context: Yusuf summarising how Titan's real-time prescription tracking eliminates the uncertainty that plagued their previous system.

extracts.quote: Batch flow has been incredible in terms of being able to process multiple prescriptions in one go. By making it as simple as that, it's probably made it even safer, infinitely more safer, if you think of doing multiple prescriptions at one time.
extracts.context: Yusuf praising batch flow for combining efficiency with safety when processing multiple prescriptions simultaneously.

extracts.quote: As long as the process of batch flow is followed as it should be, it can probably double the speed of normal dispensing.
extracts.context: Yusuf estimating the speed improvement of batch flow compared to traditional single-prescription dispensing workflows.

extracts.quote: There is an element of anxiety that can go with it, especially if you're in a really busy store. If I think about how I used to walk in blind, almost, to work every single morning, not knowing what sort of workflow I'd have to be dealing with.
extracts.context: Yusuf describing the daily dread and uncertainty pharmacists experienced before Titan's dashboard gave them visibility into their workload.

extracts.quote: Repeat flow has basically eliminated that completely. You put it on a cycle, it sends an email off to the surgery. When the prescription returns, it recognises it from the board. It tells you if you need to do any chasing. It tells you if there's been any changes. It's spectacular.
extracts.context: Yusuf describing how Repeat Flow automated the entire monthly ordering cycle for dosette patients that was previously manual paper-based work.

extracts.quote: Titan empowers the staff to be able to take control of the dispensary. They actually feel like they have more responsibility and more control over it. A pharmacist can be in the break room having their lunch and a prescription has already been clinically checked, and they come in, they can just get it done. No need to disturb the pharmacist.
extracts.context: Yusuf describing how Titan shifted the power dynamic so dispensary staff feel ownership rather than dependence on the pharmacist.

extracts.quote: Our services have increased in some branches by 500%. Even the ones that were doing some services before, because of the ability to come out of the dispensary, they've still increased by at least 300%.
extracts.context: Yusuf explaining how freeing the pharmacist from dispensary checking has directly driven massive growth in clinical service delivery across BNP Healthcare branches.

extracts.quote: UK pharmacy is in a difficult time right now. The way the government have set up our contractors is almost looking to set us up to fail. We take a different view on it completely. If we can put in a process and a system that can allow us to give our staff more time, rather than having to reduce our staff, then we will do that.
extracts.context: Yusuf rejecting the industry trend of cutting staff in response to funding pressures, instead using Titan to upskill and redeploy existing team members.

extracts.quote: Five years ago, or even 10 years ago, the industry was chasing items. We're not chasing items anymore. We're about service. That's what pharmacies should be. And Titan allows you to do that. And I can't say the same for a lot of other PMRs.
extracts.context: Yusuf advising other pharmacy owners to examine whether their PMR has evolved with the industry shift from volume to services.

extracts.quote: The AI is literally the greatest thing I've ever seen. I couldn't believe, even in this day and age with AI, how easy it is to create templates for each and every service. I'm able to create a questionnaire template for a travel vaccination course, while at the same time create ad hoc something for weight loss. It's allowed me to tailor make each consultation on the spot.
extracts.context: Yusuf expressing genuine amazement at Titanverse's AI service template builder that replaced manual paperwork for clinical consultations.

extracts.quote: Imagine before Titanverse, we would have been using a booking platform to take the booking, a manual piece of paper for the risk assessment, a manual piece of paper to write a prescription, then file that away, then go on the PMR to enter it as a prescription. This is all in one place now. Titanverse is literally incredible.
extracts.context: Yusuf walking through the before-and-after of a travel vaccination consultation, listing five separate manual steps now consolidated into one platform.

extracts.quote: With Titanverse, I'm sitting facing the patient, looking at them, having a conversation with them. Because it's picking it all up, I don't need to sit there typing away afterwards. That saved me time during, making a more friendly experience for the patient. What software has ever allowed you to do that before? None.
extracts.context: Yusuf contrasting the impersonal GP-style typing-while-talking consultation with Titanverse's voice transcription that lets the pharmacist maintain eye contact.

extracts.quote: Even I, who's been doing this service for many years, sometimes thinks, wow, even I sometimes don't think of asking those kind of questions. It's so thorough that it just provides you with the confidence to know that you can provide that service safely and also efficiently.
extracts.context: Yusuf, an experienced prescriber, admitting that Titanverse's AI-generated consultation templates are more thorough than his own clinical questioning.

extracts.quote: It's a digital prescription. I'm able to approve it. It goes straight to my board. They dispense it using Titan. I don't need to be involved in that.
extracts.context: Yusuf explaining the end-to-end digital prescription flow from Titanverse consultation to Titan PMR dispensing.

extracts.quote: Imagine, before Titanverse, we would have been using a booking platform to take the booking, a manual piece of paper for the risk assessment, a manual piece of paper to write a prescription. I'd have then needed to file that away. I'd then need to go onto the PMR to enter it as a prescription. This is all in one place.
extracts.context: Yusuf contrasting the old multi-software, paper-heavy consultation workflow with Titanverse's unified approach.

extracts.quote: Since Titanverse, since we've been giving those consultations more personable and more friendly face to face, we've definitely seen an increase in uptake.
extracts.context: Yusuf reporting that the improved patient experience from Titanverse consultations has directly increased service uptake.

extracts.quote: I'm sitting facing the patient, looking at them, having a conversation with them. Because it's picking it all up, I don't need to sit there typing away afterwards. That saved me time during, making a more friendly experience for the patient. And what software has ever allowed you to do that before? None.
extracts.context: Yusuf describing how Titanverse's voice transcription transforms consultations from typing-focused to patient-focused.

extracts.quote: The fact that Titanverse's AI module is able to create that for you on the spot, to a level of detail that even me, who's been doing this service for many years, sometimes thinks, wow, even I sometimes don't think of asking those kind of questions.
extracts.context: Yusuf, an experienced pharmacist, expressing genuine surprise at the depth of AI-generated clinical questionnaires.

extracts.quote: If someone is yet to start their clinical services programme in their pharmacy, or thinking what step they can next take to make it more efficient, Titanverse is the answer. No matter what level of experience you have, it still surprised me.
extracts.context: Yusuf's closing endorsement, aimed at pharmacies at any stage of their clinical services journey.

extracts.quote: One thing we made very clear when we first started as early adopters is that the AI needed to be learning from the correct resources. It's got to be learning from reliable resources in the UK. We use the Green Book. It's important that we knew it was a closed system, only being fed the appropriate information.
extracts.context: Yusuf explaining the importance of Titanverse's closed AI system for clinical safety, referencing the Green Book as the gold standard for travel vaccinations.
